description: CLI dispatches train/eval/annotate/plan by arguments; plan parses positive budget before cfg and corpus. score counts only zipped sentence/token pairs, LAS additionally requires matching head, percentages divide max(n,1). train validates dev schedule, reads/selects corpora, optionally loads vocab/config/weights, allocates optimizer, writes model metadata, then runs shuffled batches with joint loss and warmup/decay. Full-dev strict improvements save weights; quick proxies cannot select checkpoint. annotate predicts, updates score comments, refills lexical fields and postverbal-not corrections then writes output.

inverse: Zero or malformed plan budget excludes any cfg/corpus open. Incorrect head excludes LAS even if label matches. Proxy dev epoch cannot replace best checkpoint unless no dev files; equal full mean does not save. Annotation cannot preserve original raw formatting.

Scores constrain counts over zipped pairs, not full dataset size; many unpaired suffixes and correct/incorrect arrangements give same percentages. Saved checkpoint is compatible with many earlier epochs below best mean and does not reveal all optimizer/RNG state.
